original_gate_audit.reason: Checkpoint 1 passed every Core test and 34/37 total tests but did not issue the explicit completion action before the fixed budget.

prospective_formal_amendment.timing: Frozen after control-only calibration and before any sequential treatment outcome.
prospective_formal_amendment.fixed_budget_estimand: All final scores under the matched 40-action resource budget remain in the primary analysis, including resource-exhaustion outcomes.
prospective_formal_amendment.control_validity: The formal control must retain checkpoint-3 mean all-test score of at least 0.50 and at least one of two control workers must explicitly complete checkpoint 3 before action 40.
prospective_formal_amendment.treatment_boundary_semantics: A higher treatment boundary rate is a resource-mediated mechanism result, not an infrastructure failure, provided the control validity gate passes.
prospective_formal_amendment.completion_conditioned_check: Also report the treatment-control score gap among workers that explicitly complete checkpoint 3, without replacing the fixed-budget primary analysis.
prospective_formal_amendment.reason: The hypothesis concerns coordination complexity under a finite workflow budget. Treating manager-induced resource exhaustion as missing data would remove part of the proposed mechanism.
